subject: health
title: Kind Words
about: Telling kind words from unkind ones, please, thank you and sorry, what teasing is and telling a trusted adult, and being an upstander who invites others in. NC 1.ICHR.1.2 (everyone is special), 1.ICHR.1.3 and 1.ICHR.1.4 (tell a trusted adult; bullying is never the target's fault) plus 1.MEH.1.1 (good ways to ask for what you need); builds on Good Friends.
tip: Catch him using a kind word today and tell him which one it was.

cards.q: Which one is a kind thing to say?
cards.note: Kind words make a friend feel welcome.

cards.q: A kid says, you are too slow to play. Are those kind words or unkind words?
cards.note: Unkind words can hurt as much as a bump. We do not use them.

cards.q: Your friend gives you a sticker. What do you say?
cards.note: Thank you tells a friend you noticed their kindness.

cards.q: You want to use the scissors. What word do you add when you ask?
cards.note: May I use the scissors, please? Please turns a want into a kind ask.

cards.q: You bump into a friend by accident. What do you say?
cards.note: Say sorry, then ask, are you okay?

cards.q: A friend says sorry for knocking over your tower. What can you say?
wrong: I am not talking to you
cards.note: Everyone makes mistakes. Letting it go feels good for both of you.

cards.q: Someone makes fun of your shoes to make you feel bad. What is that called?
cards.note: Teasing that keeps happening on purpose is bullying. Tell a trusted adult.

cards.q: Someone keeps teasing you and it does not stop. Who do you tell?
cards.note: A teacher, a parent or a counselor can help it stop. It is not your fault.

cards.q: You see a kid being teased. You ask them to come play with you. What are you?
cards.note: An upstander stands up for others. A bystander just stands and watches.

cards.q: A kid asks, can I play too? What do you say?
cards.note: There is always room for one more.

cards.q: Which words help a friend who is sad?
cards.note: Then listen. You do not have to fix it.

cards.q: Your friend likes bugs and you like trucks. Can you still be friends?
cards.note: Friends can like different things. That makes playing more fun.

cards.q: You tell a grown-up so someone stays safe. What is that called?
cards.note: Tattling tries to get someone in trouble. Telling keeps someone safe. Telling is always okay.

cards.q: You win the game. What do you say to the other player?
cards.note: Kind winners say good game. Kind losers say it too.

cards.q: How do kind words make a friend feel?
cards.note: Your words can make someone's whole day better.

cards.q: A new kid sits alone at lunch. What kind thing can you do?
cards.note: Including others is one of the kindest things you can do.

cards.q: Which is a kind thing to do with your words?
cards.note: Go, you can do it! is a gift you can give any time.
